primaryExample.sentenceEn: She went out to buy some milk.

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 熄滅的；停止運作的；不在場的

primaryExample.sentenceEn: The lights are out, so we can't see anything.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 燈熄了，所以我們什麼也看不見。

secondaryExamples.sentenceEn: She's out at the moment. Can I take a message?
secondaryExamples.translationZhHant: 她現在不在。需要我幫你留話嗎？

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 不再流行或不再被接受的

primaryExample.sentenceEn: That style is out this year.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 那種風格今年不流行了。

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 公開他人原本未公開的性傾向、身分或祕密活動

primaryExample.sentenceEn: The report outed him as an undercover agent.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 那份報告揭露了他是臥底探員的身分。

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 已出版、發行或推出，現在可以取得的

primaryExample.sentenceEn: Her new album is out now.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 她的新專輯現在已經發行了。

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 某樣東西已用完或沒有存貨的，常用 out of 加上物品名稱

primaryExample.sentenceEn: He was out for a few seconds after hitting his head.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 他撞到頭後失去意識了幾秒鐘。

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 在比賽或遊戲中出局、遭淘汰的
棒球等運動中的一次出局

primaryExample.sentenceEn: The runner was out at first base.

secondaryExamples.sentenceEn: There are two outs in the inning.
secondaryExamples.translationZhHant: 這一局已經有兩個出局數。

coreMeaningZhHant: 往外、離開；也可表示熄滅或停止運作。

examples.sentenceEn: I just found out that the meeting was canceled.
examples.translationZhHant: 我剛剛才得知會議取消了。

examples.sentenceEn: We ran out of gas on the way home.
examples.translationZhHant: 我們回家途中汽油用完了。

examples.sentenceEn: The job turned out to be harder than I expected.
examples.translationZhHant: 這份工作結果比我預期的還難。

examples.sentenceEn: I work out at the gym twice a week.
examples.translationZhHant: 我每週去健身房運動兩次。

examples.sentenceEn: We need to work out a solution.
examples.translationZhHant: 我們需要想出解決辦法。

headwordExpressions.meaningZhHant: 運動健身；解決；順利發展

examples.sentenceEn: Watch out! A car is coming.
Please read the sentence out loud.
The information on this website is out of date.
examples.translationZhHant: 這個網站上的資訊已經過時了。

headwordExpressions.meaningZhHant: 過時的；資料已不適用的

examples.sentenceEn: I was out of breath after running up the stairs.
examples.translationZhHant: 我跑上樓梯後喘得上氣不接下氣。

headwordExpressions.meaningZhHant: 喘不過氣；上氣不接下氣

wordFamily.meaningZhHant: 短途出遊；集體外出活動
